rework_diagnosis.category_label: Logic/typing error in source under fix
rework_diagnosis.detected_by: ISSUE-FIXER (escalation from user-reported zig 0.16 type-pinning error)
rework_diagnosis.root_cause: In Zig 0.16, bare fn(...) function-pointer types are comptime-only. They cannot be stored as runtime struct fields or loaded through a pointer. The design at src/design/iss0624-gh591-lua-11-13-fix.md section 7.1 specified `Writer = fn(...) anyerror!void` at the field type level; the current pivot to `Writer = fn(...) void` at the field type level has the same defect. The fix is to keep the TYPE at fn(...) (comptime-only at the type level is fine) and change the FIELD to `writer: *const Writer = &defaultWriter` (pointer to const function pointer). This mirrors the LUA-12 HttpClientFn pattern at src/lua/executor.zig:84 which compiles cleanly in 0.16.
failure_evidence: zig build test-lua fails with 2 errors:
src/lua/structured_logger.zig:124:13: error: cannot load comptime-only type 'fn (?*anyopaque, []const u8) void'
src/lua_test_root.zig:150:33: error: no size available for comptime-only type 'lua.structured_logger.StructuredLogger'
zig build alone exits 0, masking the failure for the test-lua target. Only `zig build test-lua` exercises the test_root pin via pinModuleTypes and detects the comptime-only struct.

recommended_fix.summary: Mirror the LUA-12 HttpClientFn pattern at src/lua/executor.zig:84. The TYPE stays as `pub const Writer = fn (ctx: ?*anyopaque, msg: []const u8) void;` (or add anyerror back if the test fixture needs OOM signalling; either works at the type level). The FIELD becomes `writer: *const Writer = &defaultWriter;` and the CALL site remains `self.writer(self.writer_ctx, message);` (Zig auto-derefs the pointer-to-function-pointer). The initWithWriter constructor parameter becomes `writer: *const Writer` instead of `writer: Writer`.
recommended_fix.diff_sketch: See the BLOCKER section in the inner report at docs/issue-reports/WF03-GH591-20260809-step-03-ISSUE-FIXER-REWORK-DIAGNOSIS.yaml
recommended_fix.verified: Empirically against Zig 0.16.0 in scratch/ before this report (test removed after verification per the scratch rule). Pattern compiles cleanly, runs at runtime, and survives @sizeOf (the pinModuleTypes constraint).

REWORK 1: BLOCKER at src/lua/structured_logger.zig:65. The Writer field type is a bare fn(...) and is therefore comptime-only in Zig 0.16 - cannot be stored as a runtime struct field. zig build test-lua fails with errors at lines 124 and 150. FIX: change field type to `writer: *const Writer = &defaultWriter;` per the LUA-12 HttpClientFn pattern at src/lua/executor.zig:84. See context.rework_diagnosis in this handoff and the full inner report at docs/issue-reports/WF03-GH591-20260809-step-03-ISSUE-FIXER-REWORK-DIAGNOSIS.yaml.

Implement LUA-11 (variable read/write) and LUA-13 (logging) per the validated Type E design at src/design/iss0624-gh591-lua-11-13-fix.md. Production changes: (1) Add 4 fields to ExecutionContext: trace_id (default ''), pending_writes (?*StringHashMap(ScriptValue), default null), structured_logger (?*const StructuredLogger, default null), instance_state (*InstanceState, default &dummy_instance_state); declare InstanceState struct with init/deinit. (2) Modify executeSource to allocate pending_writes, install on ctx_local (the local-copy-and-pointer-install pattern already used for active_watchdog, LUA-10), call extractValueInto for the script-return path (instead of partial extractValue), and apply/discard pending_writes after lua_pcall. (3) Add extractValueInto helper that walks a Lua table recursively, allocates owned string keys/values, rejects integer table keys (LuaError.TypeError), recursive into nested tables via errdefer cleanup. (4) Implement read_variable body: read from pending_writes first (read-after-write), fall through to instance_state.variables, then to nil. (5) Implement write_variable body: extract Lua value at index 2 via extractValueInto, store in pending_writes via StringHashMap.put with dupe'd key. (6) Implement log body: build StructuredLogEntry from script args (level, message, optional context table at index 3), call StructuredLogger.log, free entry via deinit. (7) Add Writer type + writer/writer_ctx fields on StructuredLogger for test capture (default routes to std.debug.print, matching ISS-0172 stderr path). (8) New test file src/lua/iss0624_lua_11_13_test.zig with 21 named cases (12 LUA-11 + 9 LUA-13). (9) Wire new test file into src/lua_test_root.zig via the existing iss0625 pattern. (10) Update CHANGELOG.md. (11) Update docs/issues/ISS-0624.json status field (after merge lands, deferred to DOC-UPDATER step). Add per-test UUID isolation, real Lua script execution via createSandboxedState (skip on null state), defer cleanup, no mocks/stubs. Run zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, error-set check, SQL lint, test isolation, handoffs lint. All must exit 0. Commit and push to feature/WF03-GH591-20260809.
